statement_en: A neutral mutant destined to fix takes on average about 4*Ne generations, which exceeds the mean time to loss 2*(Ne/N)*ln(2N) at every population size, so the two timescales separate without bound.

what_was_tried: The plan was: named hypothesis t_fix = 4*Ne and t_loss = 2*(Ne/N)*Real.log (2*N); the timescale separation reduces to 4*N > 2*Real.log (2*N) for N >= 1, which follows from Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (log x <= x - 1 gives log (2N) <= 2N - 1, hence 2*log(2N) <= 4N - 2 < 4N).
